sources.topic: Blocking result, nonblocking acceptance, later completion query and command length

contract.service: Explicit exact-match replies with separately enabled offline task, file and variable command dispatch
contract.queue: One accepted pending request; configured acceptance/completion codes and delay; portable unsupported=1/busy=2; 1..126 printable ASCII command text
contract.waiting: Captured standalone clock/sleeper or scheduler virtual sleep; query/blocking caller receives its captured accepted result without resubmission
contract.lifetime: Accepted jobs retained on caller stop/failure; explicit polling/collection; bounded history and finite sequence
contract.persistence: Terminal reply/history/last-status state only; pending context save rejected; no automatic replay

task_command_extension.configuration: task_commands true with exact replies taking precedence
task_command_extension.lineage: Fresh KCL RUN is independent. Continued tasks retain their existing lineage and pause continuations.
task_command_extension.dispatch: Registered offline driver only. KCL_NO_WAIT RUN and CONTINUE require a scheduler. Self requests deliver after status publication.
task_command_extension.statuses: 3 unavailable or ineligible target or driver, 4 supported command with admission or synchronous execution error

file_command_extension.configuration: file_commands true with exact replies taking precedence
file_command_extension.dispatch: Explicit FILE backends and existing checked source operations. Append retains complete byte prefixes. Print and directory use existing output observations.
file_command_extension.statuses: 0 success, 4 backend/path/output error, nonzero returned FILE status plus 100. KCL_NO_WAIT separates acceptance from inline completion.

variable_command_extension.configuration: variable_commands true with exact replies taking precedence
variable_command_extension.dispatch: Explicit variable store, current source module fallback, caller default group, checked creation and rename, detached PATH edits with alias and capacity guards
variable_command_extension.statuses: 0 success, 4 inline operation error, nonzero variable result plus 200

boundaries: No shell, live KCL connection, native command parser, TP execution or physical motion
Reply codes and source wait behavior are configured offline scenarios rather than controller observations

variable_archive_extension.dispatch: Detached scalar assignment and removal. Save one portable VR envelope and load its recorded namespace with complete alias and payload checks.
variable_archive_extension.statuses: Use the variable command completion codes. Nonzero archive results are offset by 200.
